name: Shebna
bio: Shebna the scribe, along with Eliakim son of Hilkiah and Joah the recorder, went out to meet Sennacherib's officers when they came against Jerusalem and heard Rabshakeh's mocking, threatening speech. He asked Rabshakeh to speak Aramaic instead of Hebrew so the watching people wouldn't understand, but Rabshakeh refused. Shebna returned to Hezekiah with his clothes torn, reporting what had been said (2 Kings 18:18-37).
